scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.11 repairs the shared desktop migration path for existing macOS libraries on older supported schemas, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.11 repairs the Windows startup-blocking database migration reported in Issue #68, so the supported Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.11 repairs the shared Electron migration path for existing Linux Experimental libraries on older supported schemas, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
